title: Round 5, stream A: nothing hovers over a sinkhole, out of it faster and without the blob; the speed ladder back, white fastest, yellow second
context: Owner's notes 6 and 8 of 2026-11-05 on 00163b90 (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-05-round-5-ten-notes-design.md, Stream A). 6: waves emerging from sinkholes need an overhaul: a) the sinkhole is a hole, nothing hovers over it; b) emerge faster, never in the dark part for long; c) the dark simplified shapes read odd close up. 8: the enemy differential speeds back: white fastest, yellow second, masses sort themselves by speed. Branch round-5-ground from overnight-2026-10-23 fbe323c0.
decision: 6a) A record rising at its breach is born at the point it rises from (crater centre + its lip offset), not at the crater's centre: its Pearl body was added there (src/fx/creature-bodies.js spawn at e.pos) and hopped across the hole to its record, which is what the owner saw hovering. Any body drawn over an open hole takes the bowl's depth there (src/domain/hole-floor.js over src/core/sinkhole-shape.js's bowl, the floor discard's own contract; src/game-breaches.js floors() hands each hole's frame and opening): the record's stand-in through its lift (every open hole, not only its own breach), a Pearl body through the seam's hubs.sink packed into the membrane's iParams.x (the shader's iSink lowers the whole body; the core and the contact shadow follow; WebGL's sixteen attributes are spent, iParams.x was the reach the shader never reads). Over the throat a body goes on down (THROAT 4 rim radii a rim radius), no 20-radius cliff. 6b) EMERGENCE climb 1.1 -> 0.5, pop 0.3 -> 0.25; the rise starts one body under the bowl's wall at rim 0.95 along the way out (lipDepth, the rim's own bearing), not the throat's -0.55 crater radii, and ends where the body stands (the Pearl lift eased over riseDur from riseFrom; it used to step up the last 0.75 of 3 radii when the clock jumped to 1.2). 6c) A Pearl body rises without the blob; the blob stays for ?creatures=dots. 8) PEARL_PACE: the white at the audit's ceiling, 1.2 radii a second, on a 3.6-radius stride and its own stage shares (transfer 0.52 -> 0.62); the yellow at 1 as it was; every other tier capped in metres by a new `mps` (pearlSpeed's `metres`): blue 1.5, orange 1.4, green 1.3, purple 1.2, brown 1.1, black 1.0 m/s. The bestiary stage keeps its own stage shares over the white's. ENEMY_SPEC for the dot clouds: amoeba 1.15 -> 1.5, phage 0.75 -> 1.45 (over scoutufo 1.4, ghost 1.25), saucer 1.55 -> 1.2.
outcome: Measured with an untracked probe (scripts/probe-r5a.mjs: a renderer hook posing the main camera, a page-side tracker of every record's rise; before on a worktree of fbe323c0, after on the branch, port 18181 under the lock). 6a) Sector 4, 25 samples 2 s apart: at the release bursts (315-500 bodies) 137-291 bodies drawn inside an open hole's rim, 118-125 in its centre half, before; 0-19 and none central after (the birth point alone, measured before the sink). Late in the wave, a 900-1,300-body pile pushes bodies into the holes either way (mean in-rim over the run 104.7 -> 35-84, centre-half peak 125 -> 20-47); of the bodies over the bowl outside the throat, 2,430 of 2,569 floated 0.5 m or more over it before (mean 3.13 m, the bowl's full 5.5 m at worst), 2 of 2,053 after (the body's sink against the bowl's floor). Frames: before, the hole covered by a floating crowd; after, a ring of bodies rising round a clear hole (scratch probe/early-early-22m.png, -6m, -60m). 6b) Release to a visible body (opacity 0.5) after the queue's delay: median 1.266 -> 0.642 s; to a body at its walking height 1.40 -> 0.70 s. 6c) Blobs on screen 64 (the pool's cap) -> 0. --pacing (the dot clouds, the blob kept): sector 1 first contact 14.5 s on the base, 15.5 s with note 6 (+1.0; the longest gap 15 -> 14 s), 13.8 s with note 8's faster dots too (gap 20 s, arrivals 413 -> 425); the ideal defender holds. 8) m/s at the sector's pace, before -> after: amoeba 1.82 -> 2.18, phage 1.46 -> 1.75, ghost / scoutufo 1.65 = 1.65, saucer 1.61 -> 1.50, jellyfish 2.02 -> 1.50, gslime 2.24 -> 1.50, drifter 1.97 -> 1.40, corona 2.27 / shellback 2.49 -> 1.30, barbed 2.77 / prime 3.28 -> 1.20, rolling 3.33 -> 1.10, phantom 2.90 / knot 7.26 -> 1.00. test/pearl-motion.mjs green at every step; its follow audit swept ten runs of six bodies a tier for 20 s: pops white 20 -> 4, yellow 3 -> 5 (untouched), blue 4 -> 0, the rest 0; the white's cycle 1.61 -> 2.02 s, jerk p95 2,877 -> 2,078; the soft hunt's worst white step 9.40 -> 7.76 radii/s (cap 10). --pearl-story's motion audit: 0 pops every tier. The mixed column (40 amoeba, 20 ghost, 10 saucer, 6 barbed from one cell, means of the distance covered at 10 / 20 / 40 s of wall clock, the column thinned by the base's guns): before amoeba 10.7 / 16.1 / 23.4, ghost 9.8 / 13.5 / 23.3, saucer 9.8 / 13.3 / 21.2, barbed 16.7 / 10.3 / 20.5 (white, yellow and blue within a metre or two, the purple ahead at first); after amoeba 13.9 / 17.8 / 24.1, ghost 9.6 / 14.7 / 22.2, saucer 9.1 / 13.9 / 18.7, barbed 9.2 / 14.1 / 6.2: the white over the yellow by 1.9-4.3 m at every reading, the blue and the purple within noise (headless runs ~10 game seconds in 40 wall seconds, so the gaps are a quarter of a 40-game-second column's). --story-world is red at the Rotor's tracer check ('a piloted round met the terrain': 4 rounds, all 4 on bodies, so no impact on the ground to measure) on the base fbe323c0 too, every step before it passing on both.
alternatives: The spec's (i) alone, radii descending by tier (white 1.2 .. black 0.6): metres would still follow size (purple prime 2.55, the knot 4.84 m/s against the amoeba's 2.18); not ordered.
The spec's (ii), a per-tier cycleDuration: the record's walk is the radii cap, and a body's hop pace is set from its record's speed, so the base cycle changes nothing but the clamps; not used.

The white past 1 radius a second on Sky's stride: pops in the follow audit (1.1: 9 in three runs, 1.2: 14); with the 3.6 stride alone still 3-8; the longer transfer with it brings it under the old white's.
Slowing every tier under the phage's 1.46 m/s without touching the white's gait: the cored at 0.8-1.3 m/s, a bigger change than the owner asked for.
A separate iSink vertex attribute: past WebGL's sixteen (test/surface-hubs.mjs guards it).

Widening CRATER_DODGE for the hole a wave rises from (the spec's second half of 6a): measured unneeded for the release (in-rim bodies at the release bursts 137-291 -> 0-19 from the birth point alone); the late in-rim bodies are the kit's separation pushing a 900-body pile's bodies, which a record offset does not move. Left open.
